page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.16-128 is an Arm-based virtual machine configured with Ampere AmpereOne processors running at a constant frequency of 3.0 GHz. The system provides 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs using a single-thread-per-core topology, avoiding the execution jitter and cache contention often associated with simultaneous multithreading. Memory is provisioned at 128 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4 GB RAM per vCPU.

This server instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage, meaning operating system disks and persistent application data must be attached through network-attached block volumes. Graphic processing accelerators are not present, with zero GPUs included on the host. Network access is supported by one complimentary public IPv4 address for direct ingress and egress routing.

The dedicated single-threaded design of the Ampere platform provides steady compute throughput and resource isolation across all 32 cores. Operating without local high-speed scratch disks represents a tradeoff for workloads requiring low-latency ephemeral I/O. VM.Standard.A2.Flex.16-128 is suited for horizontally scaled web services, microservice clusters, CI/CD compilation runners, API gateways, and general business applications compiled for the arm64 instruction set.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.16-128 is a balanced general-purpose virtual machine based on the arm64 architecture. Powered by 3.0 GHz Ampere AmpereOne processors, the instance provisions 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading, ensuring predictable per-core execution. The processor setup is paired with 128 GB of RAM, preserving a uniform 4 GB per vCPU distribution suitable for memory-stable multi-threaded services. This configuration contains no onboard local storage, necessitating external network block storage for persistent data, and includes zero hardware GPUs. One complimentary public IPv4 address provides base external networking connectivity. Thanks to the power efficiency and dedicated core design of the Ampere platform, VM.Standard.A2.Flex.16-128 provides predictable compute capacity without hyperthreading overhead. It is well suited for containerized microservices, build pipelines, web application servers, data processing tasks, and general-purpose enterprise software natively built for 64-bit Arm architectures.
